experiments.reason: Accuracy confidence interval crosses no improvement

experiments.hypothesis: Audit availability and timestamps of historical full-game prices before specifying an edge test
experiments.outcome: Coverage supports closing-line calibration/baseline research from 2010 onward; source quote timestamps are absent, so it cannot support executable decision-time ROI or model promotion.

experiments.hypothesis: One of multiplicative/additive/power de-vig converges significantly closer to the method-specific LOBO closing consensus (paired t-tests, Holm-Bonferroni)
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 162 snapshots, 291586 quotes
experiments.outcome: multiplicative wins both pairwise comparisons (Holm p ~1e-75 vs additive, ~1e-63 vs power); selects the de-vig formula for forward-shadow calibration only. Primary metric (log-loss vs settled outcomes) untestable: no outcomes stored for the historical dataset. Nothing promoted from SHADOW. Identity audit 2026-09-12: 937 provider-id "events" = 825 canonical games (816 regular-season + 9 playoff-weekend listings) + 112 phantom splits from provider id churn. Fixed keying ((home,away) + 7-day kickoff clustering); local re-run: 812 games, 109,985 cells, decision unchanged (multiplicative). 5 regression tests added.

experiments.hypothesis: Pinnacle leads followers (Track A); stale cross-book quotes beat the close via a lagging mechanism (Track B). Preregistered with Amendment A1 (pre-results) replacing Track B's miscalibrated t-test with a directional lag test.
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 162 snapshots, 291586 quotes, 825 canonical games
experiments.outcome: Track A: no book significant after Holm (best FanDuel p=0.102); pooled agree rate 0.526 (+2.6pp, p=0.0125) too small to trade; reverse falsification clean. Track B: lagging fraction 0.348, p=0.995 — no stale-price mechanism; superseded naive t-test would have falsely reported p~2.6e-176. Both tracks: no edge found.

experiments.hypothesis: Ridge model on Wed/Sat market features predicts closing consensus fair prob better than carry-forward (leave-one-season-out, one paired test).
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 704 complete (game, market) units
experiments.outcome: Primary test significant (p=3.0e-06) and model beats Sat carry-forward in 3/3 seasons, but RMSE gain 0.000928 (0.09pp) is far below the preregistered 0.003 practical bar. Verdict: no_edge. The Sat consensus is already nearly optimal.

experiments.hypothesis: Challenger v1 residual r = chal_fair - f_sat predicts closing move (OLS move ~ r, one-sided slope test). Challenger audited point-in-time safe: train_end=2021, static ratings.
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 704 units with challenger predictions
experiments.outcome: Primary test not significant (slope +0.0010, p=0.1218); per-season slopes all ~+0.001. Verdict: no_edge. Stale 2021 ratings disagree wildly with market (mean |r|=0.36) but carry no information about closing movement. Consistent with the challenger's gate refusal.

experiments.hypothesis: Best available same-snapshot price across books beats strict LOBO closing consensus beyond the mechanical best-price selection effect under a calibrated noise null.
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 825 canonical games
experiments.outcome: Observed mean game-level CLV +0.00647 was below the simulated mechanical-shopping null mean +0.00675; observed-vs-null p=0.998. No harvestable execution edge.

experiments.hypothesis: Pinnacle's Wednesday fair-probability deviation from the cross-book consensus predicts the direction and magnitude of the closing move.
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 325 units across 289 games
experiments.outcome: Direction agreement 0.375 (103/275), one-sided p approximately 1.0; consensus-priced strategy mean CLV +0.0005, p=0.24. The exploratory reversal has no tradeable magnitude.

experiments.hypothesis: After a capped feasibility and historical pilot, best available moneyline price beats strict LOBO closing consensus beyond a calibrated mechanical-shopping noise null.
experiments.source: 2024 moneyline pilot, 54 snapshots, 47236 normalized quotes, 281 games, 1380 best-price cells
experiments.outcome: Observed mean per-game CLV +0.01172 cleared the zero-based practical bar but was fully explained by the simulated noise null mean +0.01156; observed-vs-null p=0.216. No edge.

experiments.hypothesis: Coordinated multi-book fair-probability moves predict continuation to the closing consensus.
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 123 steam events across 110 games
experiments.outcome: Closing direction agreed 45.2% (47/104, six ties), one-sided p=0.86; mean post-steam CLV +0.0002, p=0.40, below the 0.01 practical bar. No momentum edge.
